name: breakout20-swing
title: 20-day breakout swing
description: Swing, delivery (CNC). Buy at the next open after a close above the highest high of the previous 20 sessions. Stop 2 ATR(14) under the entry; sell at the next open after a close under the lowest low of the previous 10 sessions, or after 30 sessions.
references: Richard Donchian's channel breakout; the Turtle rules (Curtis Faith, Way of the Turtle, 2007)
